cover.title: 7 words your coding agent will say. And what they mean.
cover.sub: Read once. Then you can read any agent report.

items.title: Project folder
items.text: The only folder you open. The agent keeps two things inside: the repository and its work desks.

items.title: main
items.text: The clean copy of your project. Nobody edits it by hand. Changes arrive only by merge.

items.title: Worktree
items.text: A separate desk for one task. The agent builds there, then merges. Two agents, two desks, no collisions.

items.title: Check
items.text: One command: formatter, linter, types, tests. Red means not done. No exceptions.

items.title: Pull request
items.text: A change waiting at the door. The check runs, a human says yes, the change goes in.

items.title: Glass
items.text: One page where the state of the machine is visible without reading code. Decisions, last check, live address.

items.title: Key
items.text: The one thing the agent never touches. You put it where it lives. The agent checks only its name.
